about: Step 3.3 knowledge set for knowledge/host-store (3 policy documents). Written by Claude Code after writing the policies, phrased the way store staff talk, avoiding the policy wording where possible. Each expect entry is a group of acceptable chunk ids; the answer needs one chunk from every group. Tags: policy (rules only), mixed (needs the policy and store data). notCovered: questions the policies do not answer; the agent must say so instead of citing.
